scope: Three paired continuations per condition on each of 131 fixed eligible source checkpoints; uncertainty resamples 131 items, never 393 independent pairs.

methods.primary: For each item, average its three binary outcomes within each condition; subtract Full from TOC, then average these 131 paired differences.
methods.item_bootstrap: Resample 131 complete items with replacement, retaining all three rounds and both arms; 95% percentile interval.
methods.setup_bootstrap: Sensitivity: resample 19 author setups with replacement, retaining every item, all three rounds and both arms in each sampled setup. Compute sampled item-weighted mean difference (ratio of sum differences to sampled item count).
methods.setup_map: human_evaluation/scenarios.json original item-ID ranges; all setups except S17 are represented. No older 21-stem grouping is used.
methods.cap: Actual frozen report character count from each checkpoint/manifest, with exactly 100000 included in the untruncated stratum.
methods.keyed_value_layer: Reuse frozen_replay_gpt52_round1/item_analysis.json. Existing mechanism matcher make_spec/clean_text/match_text applies option-precision numeric matching, quantity sign handling, and specific-conductance context restrictions. A numeric occurrence is not semantic verification that the requested quantity was correctly computed.
methods.grading: Read final_answer.txt independently; parse the first <<<...>>> wrapper containing exactly one A-D letter (case-insensitive), compare to verified dataset key. Missing/unparseable answer is incorrect for accuracy; compare against stored prediction/is_correct fields.
methods.inference: No pooled McNemar test is performed. These intervals describe uncertainty over items/setups conditional on the fixed source checkpoints and three observed repeats; they do not cover source-trajectory selection or reconstruction uncertainty.
